question: When did India win its last gold medal in Hockey in the Olympics?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1980**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• India won its last gold medal in Hockey at the **1980 Summer Olympics** held in Moscow.

• This victory marked India's **eighth gold medal in field hockey** at the Olympics.

• India defeated Spain with a score of **4-3** in the final match to secure the gold medal.

• The 1980 gold medal win was significant as it was the first Olympic gold for India in hockey after a gap of 16 years, the previous one being in 1964.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Field Hockey at the Olympics**

• Field hockey has been a part of the Olympics since the 1908 London Games.

• It was excluded from the 1924 Paris Olympics and reintroduced in the 1928 Amsterdam Olympics.

• India has been one of the most successful teams in the history of Olympic field hockey, with a total of 8 gold medals.

• India's dominance in Olympic field hockey was most prominent from 1928 to 1956, during which the team won six consecutive gold medals.

• **1980 Summer Olympics**

• The 1980 Summer Olympics, officially known as the Games of the XXII Olympiad, were held in Moscow, USSR, from July 19 to August 3, 1980.

• The games were marked by a large boycott led by the United States in protest of the Soviet invasion of Afghanistan.

• Despite the boycott, athletes from 80 countries participated in the event.

• The 1980 Olympics were the first to be held in Eastern Europe.

• **Indian Hockey Team**

• The Indian men's hockey team is governed by Hockey India, the apex body for field hockey in India.

• India's hockey team has a rich history, being one of the most decorated teams in the sport.

• In addition to their Olympic success, the Indian team has also won the Hockey World Cup and the Asian Games.

• The team's consistent performance in international competitions has contributed to the popularity of field hockey in India.
